backlog_items.title: Interactive Candidate Email Outreach Template Visualizer & Preview
backlog_items.business_value: High - Allows recruiters to review and customize AI-generated candidate outreach emails prior to SMTP delivery via Hostinger.
backlog_items.technical_value: High - Integrates NotificationService and HostingerService with explicit UI template rendering and variable substitution.
acceptance_criteria: Recruiter can view generated candidate email body in visual editor modal
SMTP dispatch via HostingerService succeeds and updates outreach status in repository
backlog_items.definition_of_done: UI modal added to RecruitmentIntelligencePanel, backend API endpoint verified, test suite passes clean.
